name: How long does a typical wheelchair ramp repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical wheelchair ramp repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wheelchair ramp repair depends on the extent of the damage and the materials involved. Minor repairs like replacing a few boards or tightening fasteners might take a few hours. More extensive issues, such as structural damage or widespread material replacement, could require a full day or multiple days. We assess each situation to provide an accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on damage severity, from a few hours for minor fixes to multiple days for significant structural issues.
